info.name: Code Matrix Instagram Theme
info.description:
Transform your Instagram experience with the Code Matrix theme, inspired by the iconic hacker aesthetic. Featuring dark backgrounds and neon green accents, this theme provides a sleek, high-tech look.

Features:

Background: Deep black (#0d0d0d) for a minimalist feel.

Text: Neon green (#00ff00) for a striking contrast.

Navigation Bar: Dark grey (#1a1a1a) to focus on the content.

Links: Neon green (#00ff00) to match the text.

Buttons and Input Fields: Stylish dark grey (#1a1a1a) with neon green text.

Perfect for tech enthusiasts and those who appreciate a futuristic look. Enjoy your new theme!
